d:
Ilaaka Doon City" is an anthem celebrating the grit and resilience of Doon City's people. It highlights their unbreakable spirit, pride, and determination to overcome challenges, emphasizing the unforgettable faces and strong attitudes of the locals.
Song Credits:
Track Name: Ilaaka Doon City
Written & Performed By: Vichaar
Music Producer: Aditya Pushkarna
Primary Artist: Vichaar
Track Name: Ilaaka Doon City
Singer/Performed By/Cast: Vichaar
